audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] reads 'Overheat his Silver Spitter to triple Flamespitter damage'. 'Silver Spitter' is not an ability in Rumble's kit, and Overheat does the opposite of what the line claims: at 100% Heat Rumble is UNABLE TO CAST SPELLS, gaining attack speed and bonus auto damage instead. The bonus ability effects come from Danger Zone at 50% Heat.
audit.why: It inverts the most important timing in the lane. Overheat is not his burst window, it is YOUR window — a Rumble at 100% Heat cannot Flamespitter, cannot harpoon, cannot Scrap Shield, and has no answer to a hook. The page told the player to fear exactly the moment they should walk in.
audit.corrected: Danger Zone (50% Heat) empowers his abilities; Overheat (100%) locks him out of casting entirely — step up on the Overheat, not away from it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 3 is Skill though whys[3] says he keeps you out of range through 4-5; row 4 is Skill though whys[4], spikes[2] and mid all call level 6 'your ONE real window'. The header also says diff EVEN while diffRating is 8.5/10, tone is the red token and report[14] says 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill / Rumble x3 / Nautilus / Rumble / Rumble, matching the prose; and 44.44% with an 8.5 rating is not EVEN.
audit.corrected: Row 3 to Rumble, row 4 to Nautilus in both layers as one atomic group; diff EVEN to HARD so the four difficulty fields finally agree.

audit.why: His level 1-2 Flamespitter, his level 3 harpoon, your level 6, his Liandry's first item. Right ladder; spikes[0] now also carries the Overheat window.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] rewritten to state the Overheat punish.

audit.why: _missing lists 'Both sides carry displacement (Dredge Line vs Scrap Shield)' and 'Rumble can cut your retreat with Scrap Shield'. Scrap Shield's knockup and terrain flags are a parsing misfire — Riot's text is a shield plus a burst of move speed, with no displacement and no terrain. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion and did not propagate it either.
audit.corrected: Not written. The Equalizer half is real and is already on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: early, mid and late are written in the first person ('my passive root', 'that's my cleanest all-in'), and wants.foe[1] has a broken clause: 'while struts away on W'.
audit.why: Voice break plus a grammatical error on a paying page.
audit.corrected: All three paragraphs converted to second person; wants.foe[1] rewritten.

edits.before: Overheat his Silver Spitter to triple Flamespitter damage and melt your tank HP while struts away on W
edits.after: Sit in Danger Zone at 50% Heat so Flamespitter and the harpoon slow burn your tank HP down

edits.before: Rumble's first Flamespitter chunks you the moment you walk up to last-hit; respect his Heat-free early DPS before he can overheat.
edits.after: Flamespitter chunks you the moment you walk up to last-hit — but at 100% Heat he Overheats and cannot cast at all, so that is your step-up.

edits.before: Level 1 is roughly even — neither of us has a real all-in yet, and my passive root makes a single auto-trade fine if he steps up. But the second he hits Flamespitter you cannot facetank it: standing in the flame to last-hit donates free Heat damage to him. By 3 it tilts hard — his E harpoon slows me so I can't close Q range, and he just struts away on W move speed and burns me. Don't throw Q at him in the open; he'll be gone before I'm pulled in, and a missed Q leaves me naked with no gap-close.
edits.after: Level 1 is roughly even — neither of you has a real all-in yet, and your passive root makes a single auto-trade fine if he steps up. But the second he has Flamespitter you cannot facetank it: standing in the cone to last-hit just feeds him Heat. By 3 it tilts hard — Electro Harpoon slows you out of hook range and he struts off on Scrap Shield's speed. Don't throw the hook in the open. Watch his Heat bar instead: at 100% he Overheats and cannot cast anything, and that is when you walk in.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are his — Flamespitter and the E slow keep me out of range and chip my HP every time I walk to the wave. Level 6 is my ONE real window: Depth Charge is homing and undodgeable, so I can R him through his own Equalizer, pull with Q, and stack passive-root into E-slow before his W shield and move-speed kick him free. If I don't kill or burn a Flash there, he resets the kite. Bait his Equalizer onto empty ground first — once it's down, that's my cleanest all-in.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his — Flamespitter and the harpoon slow keep you out of range and chip you every time you walk to the wave. Level 6 is your ONE real window: Depth Charge homes and cannot be dodged, so ult him through his own Equalizer, pull, and stack root into Riptide before Scrap Shield's speed burst frees him. If you don't kill him or burn a Flash there, he resets the kite. Bait The Equalizer onto empty ground first — it is 130s at rank 1, and that gap is your cleanest all-in.

edits.before: This goes the wrong way late and you have to accept it. His Liandry's burn scales off my max HP, so building tank only feeds his damage while mine stays flat — I'm a CC-bot, not a threat to him. He zones whole fights with Equalizer and kites with W. My only value is landing R on his carry and peeling; don't try to 1v1 him, and don't splitpush into him — he'll poke me off the wave and walk away every time. Win this on the map with ganks and objectives, not in a sidelane duel.
edits.after: This goes the wrong way late and you have to accept it. His Liandry's burn scales off your max HP, so stacking tank only feeds his damage while yours stays flat — you are a CC-bot, not a threat to him. He zones whole fights with The Equalizer and kites on Scrap Shield. Your value is landing Depth Charge on his carry and peeling; don't 1v1 him and don't splitpush into him — he pokes you off the wave every time. Win this on the map, not in a sidelane duel.

notes: The worst error on this page was backwards advice: wants.foe[1] told the player Rumble 'overheats to triple Flamespitter damage' via a non-existent ability called Silver Spitter. Overheat at 100% Heat locks him out of casting entirely — it is the player's engage window, not his burst window, and that is now stated in early and in spikes[0]. Danger Zone at 50% Heat is the empowerment threshold. diff read EVEN while diffRating, tone and report[14] all said hard; set to HARD. Chart rows 3 and 4 flipped in both layers as one atomic group. Packet suspectNames 'His Flamespitter' and 'Drop Equalizer' are both false positives — Flamespitter and The Equalizer are real. Kit-file flag misfire confirmed with the mirror: Scrap Shield's knockup and terrain flags are wrong; Riot's text is a shield plus move speed.
